name: Zetogeki Hide Armor
effects: Until the end of your next turn (once per day): resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and every Speed drops by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet).

name: Bioluminescent Stripes
effects: While the stripes glow (activate 1 action, dismiss as a free action): Stealth drops by 4 (a -4 item penalty), applying to Hide and Sneak. Note: you can't be undetected, and you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius plus dim light for the next 20 feet.

name: Blessed Tattoo
effects: While active (1 minute): AC rises by 1 and every saving throw rises by 1 (a +1 status bonus), applying only against attacks, spells and effects created by evil/unholy creatures.

name: Curse of Engulfing Flames
effects: While active: you take persistent fire damage equal to your cursebound value, and any fire immunity or fire resistance you have is suppressed (treated as none). Ends while Refocusing to assuage the curse or while unconscious.

name: Electric Counter
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn): resistance to electricity equal to your level.

name: Gathering Moss
effects: While active (1 minute, or until Tenacious Stance ends): fast healing equal to your level.

name: Immortal Techniques
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn): 20 temporary Hit Points, gained the first time each round you use an action with the monk and stance traits.

name: Inexorable Iron
effects: While in Arcane Cascade stance wielding a melee weapon in two hands: gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) on entering the stance and at the start of each of your turns.

name: Klingegeist
effects: Alternate form (10 minutes or until Dismissed): AC becomes 18 + your level; you gain a fly Speed of 30 feet; you are trained in the possessed slashing weapon unless already better; you can take only Strike and Fly actions.

name: Leopard's Armor
effects: 1 hour: +2 item bonus to Stealth; +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks to Demoralize; -2 penalty to Diplomacy; -2 penalty to Society.

name: Pyrefeather Token
effects: 1 minute: 5 temporary Hit Points. On activation it also reduces the DC of the triggering recovery check by 1.

name: Renewing Cycle
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn): temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, gained the first time each round you Cycle Elemental Stance.

name: Soaring Wings (Major)
effects: While active: gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. No frequency limit; lasts until you Dismiss it. No other statistic changes.

name: Stone Body
effects: While active: resistance 10 to all damage. Requires Tenacious Stance; ends at the end of your next turn or immediately when you are critically hit.

name: Stone Brawler Dedication
effects: While in the stance you can make stonestrike attacks: 1d8 bludgeoning, brawling group, traits forceful, magical, unarmed. Requires that you are standing on the ground. (Text verified against core.actions['stonestrike-stance'].)

name: Winged
effects: While active: gain a fly Speed equal to 25 feet or your land Speed, whichever is SLOWER. Lasts 5 minutes or until Dismissed; once per hour (the existing counters/frequency already track that).

name: Wyrm's Flight
effects: While active: gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. Lasts 10 minutes or until Dismissed, once per day; at 17th level the duration is unlimited and there is no frequency limit.

name: Raging Stories
effects: While active (you Offered a Story and chose the spectral-flame benefit): every MELEE Strike deals +2 additional fire damage; +4 instead if you are a master in Religion, +6 if legendary. Ranged Strikes unaffected.
